title: PT1 — Physics in My Daily Life: Quality of Life Mapping Portfolio
shortTitle: PT1 — Physics in My Daily Life
summary: Map how physics concepts improve the quality of life in four areas: household, health & safety, work productivity, and leisure.
instructions:
Your task is to create a visual portfolio (digital or printed) that maps the role of physics in your everyday life. You will:

  1. Choose 4 real-life situations — one from each area: household, health & safety, work productivity, and leisure.
  2. For each situation, identify at least one physics concept at work (e.g., friction, gravity, torque, pressure, refraction).
  3. Provide a photo, drawing, or screenshot of the situation.
  4. Write a 3–5 sentence explanation per situation, describing the physics and how it improves your life.
  5. End with a 1-paragraph reflection on how physics shapes your daily routines.

Format: PDF, DOCX, or a 4–6 slide presentation. Submit as a file.
requirements: At least 4 situations — one from each life area
One clear physics concept identified per situation
At least one image/diagram per situation
Proper citation of any external sources used

rubric.criterion: Content accuracy (physics concepts correctly identified and explained)
Coverage of all four life areas
